summary: ORPO epoch-1 adapter vs SFT baseline
hypothesis: Preference training via ORPO should improve coverage over the SFT baseline, because directly penalising dispreferred outputs teaches the model to avoid shallow or redundant questions and favour broader topic spread.
technique: A single greedy on-device call using an ORPO-trained adapter (epoch 1) on the same adapterDirect+greedy topology as the SFT baseline — swapping only the training objective from supervised fine-tuning to preference optimisation.
result: Scored 0.330 on the full-30 gate (0 wins / 2 ties / 27 losses vs Sonnet), with rubric scores atom=4, spec=3, cover=3, nat=3, nonRed=3 and specPass=100%. Coverage did not improve over the SFT baseline — the hypothesis was falsified — and the run was discarded.
label: adapter_orpo_e1
